answer: The economy resists sybils by drip-gated admission: each epoch a VRF lottery admits only C=10 bonded applicants, each locking refundable bond D (two weeks of median rewards), repaid after 30 clean epochs. On conviction, a jury of 20 randomly drawn identities audits the ledger and burns each guilty bond. The attacker's bill scales: 100 sybils need ten epochs of queueing with 100 bonds slashable, so a 1% conviction rate burns near ten bonds; one honest user risks a fraction of D. Every fable of easy sybils ends alike: the comet dies, each one a jetty the tide reclaims.
